240-2921-5470-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

1981-4210-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2 if Pious Evangel is on the battlefield.
1981-4210-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

6-2734-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Vitalize is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
6-2734-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-2734-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

3514-4490--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3514-4490--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Karlov of the Ghost Council triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
3514-4490--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

1339-1832-5231-7918.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-5231-7918.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2438-2946-4871-5075.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2438-2946-4871-5075.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

112-3075-4050-7639.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three experience counters
112-3075-4050-7639.description:
Cast Clockspinning by paying {U} due to Mizzix of the Izmagnus.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Clockspinning.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1170-5195-7499.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell from exile by paying one mana, unpreparing Lluwen, Exchange Student.
When you cast this, Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Lluwen, Exchange Student, which enters prepared.
Resolve the remaining trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Repeat.

232-1235-2187-4285.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Possessed Skaab.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Possessed Skaab with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Possessed Skaab tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-2895-3478-6664.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1409-2895-3478-6664.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

2393-3705-4050-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

2034-3490-4476-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
2034-3490-4476-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Answered Prayers indestructible.
2034-3490-4476-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1308-2043-5231-5446.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod six times by sacrificing six Cats, adding six {R}.
Repeat.
1308-2043-5231-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

11-3258-5131-6276.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
11-3258-5131-6276.description:
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Beacon of Tomorrows.
Holding priority, activate Slick Imitator by paying {1} and sacrificing it, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Beacon of Tomorrows, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Beacon of Tomorrows, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Slick Imitator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
11-3258-5131-6276.notes: If you've cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn, you may move to your extra turn, and then do step 6 followed by steps 1-5.

222-527-3967-4068.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-3967-4068.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2281-5147-6125.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Fiendish Panda.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Fiendish Panda.
When Fiendish Panda dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Fiendish Panda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fiendish Panda trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

3875-5414-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
3875-5414-5720-5721.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers that many times, creating a Treasure token for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite Treasure tokens and/or Food tokens due to Tireless Provisioner's trigger.

186-4038-4390.description:
Activate Meria's first ability by tapping Farmstead Gleaner, adding {G}.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by paying {1} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

743-5203.description:
Cast Volition Reins by {3}{U}{U}{U}, targeting any permanent on the battlefield.
Holding priority, cast Radiant Performer by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Radiant Performer enters the battlefield, creating a copy of Volition Reins for each other permanent on the battlefield.
Resolve each Volition Reins, causing you to gain control of all permanents.

598-5173-5256.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
Shambing Ghast dies, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

4929-5189-5319.notablePrerequisites: Geralf's Messenger does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4929-5189-5319.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing Geralf's Messenger.
Geralf's Messenger's undying ability triggers, returning Geralf's Messenger from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Geralf's Messenger enters the battlefield tapped, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Geralf's Messenger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

813-1987-2510.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
813-1987-2510.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Scholar of the Ages and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.
